Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: IKEA Cabinet Greenhouse & Hydroponic Parametric Upgrades
proposals.buyer_persona: Indoor urban plant hobbyists (using IKEA Milsbo/Rudsta cabinets as indoor greenhouses) who need custom ventilation, cable management, and modular shelves, utilizing local or personal 3D printers.
product_angles: OpenSCAD parametric brackets for USB fans matching IKEA cabinet frames
Modular hydroponic net cup holders with adjustable clip diameters
Parametric magnetic cable routing clips for high-humidity environments
proposals.first_test_product: Parametric corner fan mount bracket for IKEA Milsbo greenhouse cabinet (STL file sold on Cults3D/Etsy)

proposals.name: Playdate Console & 1-Bit Retro Handheld Gamedev Assets
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building games for the Playdate console (crank-operated, 1-bit screen) or classic GameBoy-like homebrew engines, looking for ready-to-use aesthetic assets.
product_angles: 1-bit dithered tilemaps and parallax background sets (400x240 optimized)
Retro physical crank UI element sprite-sheets and indicator icons
8-bit sound effects pack specifically mixed for low-spec speaker hardware
proposals.first_test_product: 1-Bit Retro Sci-Fi Interface & Icon Sprite Pack (optimized for Playdate 400x240 resolution, sold on Itch.io/Etsy)

proposals.name: Custom Mechanical Keyboard (Keeb) Community Deskmats & Decals
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech workers, gamers, and software developers who spend hundreds of euros on custom mechanical keyboards and desire high-aesthetic matching deskmats and layout templates.
product_angles: Ortholinear and split ergonomic keyboard layout schematic deskmats
Retro patent drawings of mechanical switches stylized as vector line art
Insider jokes/acronyms decals (e.g., 'Lubed & Clipped', 'ANSI > ISO') for PC cases
proposals.first_test_product: Minimalist Mechanical Switch Technical Blueprint Deskmat Design (Redbubble/Printify)

proposals.name: Spearfishing & Freediving (Chasse sous-marine) Logbooks & SVG Decals
proposals.buyer_persona: Passionate underwater hunters and freedivers who track tides, depth, water temp, and fish sightings. They strongly identify with the sport and love gear customization.
product_angles: Freediving and spearfishing session logbook with tide and breath-hold metrics
Minimalist vector cut-files (SVG) for carbon fins decoration
Target fish species line-art decals for boat hulls or gear cases
proposals.first_test_product: Spearfishing Log & Tide Tracker Notebook (KDP French/English editions)

proposals.name: Ham Radio (Amateur Radio) DXing Logbooks & QSL Card Templates
proposals.buyer_persona: Licensed radio operators worldwide who log daily long-distance radio contacts (DXing) and exchange custom physical postcards (QSL cards) to confirm contacts.
product_angles: Printable vintage-style QSL card template bundles editable in free tools
Solar cycle and signal propagation tracking logbooks
Phonetic alphabet (Alpha, Bravo...) reference posters and mugs
proposals.first_test_product: DXer Amateur Radio Logbook with Solar Cycle Tracker (KDP paperback)

proposals.name: French 'Plus Beaux Villages de France' / Local Heritage B2B Illustrative Prints
proposals.buyer_persona: Local tourism offices, regional gift shops, and proud residents of designated historic French villages looking for modern, minimalist vector representations of their town's unique architecture.
product_angles: Minimalist architectural line-art posters of specific village landmarks
Vector SVG assets of regional coats of arms and geographic silhouettes
Custom local history coloring sheets for regional tourist offices
proposals.first_test_product: Minimalist architectural poster of Rochefort-en-Terre (SVG layout generated and sold as physical print via local partner or Etsy)
